name: com.haochezhu.ubm.detectors.gms.geofence.GeofenceBroadcastReceiver
description: When Google reports that the phone crossed a monitored location boundary, the UBM SDK passes the geofence event into its tracking flow. Disabling it can stop location-based trip or place-change tracking.
disableEffect: UBM may stop responding to monitored location boundaries and may miss related trip events.
